task_name: Slack introduction community map evidence rerun
instruction:
Inspect up to the 12 most recent substantive introductions in #intro. For each person, report the displayed name, timestamp, location, role or organization, technical
    interests, and reason for joining when explicitly stated. Mark fields not present as not stated. Then summarize recurring locations, roles, and interests without inventing
    missing information. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content.
